leaf.result: The pinned official Cargo configuration reference defines net.offline as a boolean defaulting false; when true Cargo avoids accessing the network and attempts to proceed with locally cached data. It is also exposed as CARGO_NET_OFFLINE and can be overridden with --offline.
leaf.semantic_inference: Together with the immediately preceding own-role source-replacement finding, Cargo documents a configuration-level path where a local directory replacement can be paired with net.offline=true so Cargo is instructed not to fall back to network access. This does not prove successful resolution when required local/vendor data are absent, does not prove initial vendor population without network or execution, and does not remove Cargo execution itself from the outcome path.
